belongs_to: Question 16 (Figure it Out): 'Which of the following Venn diagrams captures the relationship between the multiples of 4, 8, and 32?' - option (i) (printed answer: (iv)); reprinted with the question on the solutions page
description: Option (i) of Q16, printed top-left, small label '(i)' to its left. Three plain ellipses in a horizontal chain, each wider than tall, all at the same height: LEFT ellipse light blue (labelled Multiples of 4); MIDDLE ellipse light yellow (labelled Multiples of 8); RIGHT ellipse light green (labelled Multiples of 32). The left and middle ellipses overlap in a lens (light green-yellow, the colours blended); the middle and right ellipses overlap in a second lens (a darker green). The left and right ellipses do NOT touch or overlap each other (a gap between them), so no region is common to all three. All outlines thin grey. Labels, left to right under the figure: 'Multiples of 4' with a dashed arrow starting at the lower-left edge of the blue ellipse and pointing down-left; 'Multiples of 8' with a dashed arrow starting INSIDE the yellow ellipse at its centre (just right of the left lens) and pointing straight down; 'Multiples of 32' with a dashed arrow starting at the lower-right edge of the green ellipse and pointing down-right. Each label is two lines of text ('Multiples' above 'of N') at the lower end of a black dashed arrow with a filled arrowhead. Meaning of the drawing: 4 and 8 share elements, 8 and 32 share elements, 4 and 32 share none (not the correct answer).
unclear: Printed with a faint diagonal 'NCERT not to be republished' watermark crossing the page; it is not part of the figure.

belongs_to: Question 16 (Figure it Out): 'Which of the following Venn diagrams captures the relationship between the multiples of 4, 8, and 32?' - option (ii) (printed answer: (iv)); reprinted with the question on the solutions page
description: Option (ii) of Q16, printed top-right (right of option (i)), small label '(ii)' to its upper left. TWO plain ellipses only (no third set drawn), side by side, same height: LEFT ellipse light blue (Multiples of 4), RIGHT ellipse light yellow; they overlap in a lens (light green). Thin grey outlines. Three labels sit under the figure, left to right, each with a dashed arrow: 'Multiples of 4' arrow starts at the lower-left edge of the blue ellipse and points down-left; 'Multiples of 8' arrow starts INSIDE the overlap lens (at the lens centre) and points straight down; 'Multiples of 32' arrow starts at the lower-right edge of the yellow ellipse and points down-right. Each label is two lines of text ('Multiples' above 'of N') at the lower end of a black dashed arrow with a filled arrowhead. The three labels are crowded close together (their texts nearly touch). Meaning of the drawing: only two circles for three sets, so it cannot show 4, 8 and 32 separately (not the correct answer).
unclear: Which set the yellow ellipse itself stands for is not stated: the 'of 8' arrow points into the overlap lens and the 'of 32' arrow starts at the yellow ellipse edge, so the figure is deliberately inconsistent/ambiguous.
Faint watermark crosses the page; not part of the figure.

belongs_to: Question 16 (Figure it Out): 'Which of the following Venn diagrams captures the relationship between the multiples of 4, 8, and 32?' - option (iii) (printed answer: (iv)); reprinted with the question on the solutions page
description: Option (iii) of Q16, printed in the second row, left, small label '(iii)' to its upper left. THREE nested filled shapes (each wholly inside the next, no part sticking out): OUTER large circle pale green; MIDDLE ellipse/circle yellow (smaller, inside the outer one, sitting slightly right of and below the outer centre, its bottom edge close to but inside the outer circle's bottom); INNER small circle teal-green (inside the yellow one, again slightly right and below its centre). Thin grey/dark outlines. Labels under the figure, left to right: 'Multiples of 32' with a dashed arrow from the lower-left rim of the outer pale-green ring, pointing down-left (so OUTER = multiples of 32); 'Multiples of 8' with a dashed arrow from the bottom edge of the yellow ellipse pointing straight down (MIDDLE = multiples of 8); 'Multiples of 4' with a dashed arrow starting INSIDE the innermost teal circle at its lower right, running down-right across the yellow and green areas (INNER = multiples of 4). Each label is two lines of text ('Multiples' above 'of N') at the lower end of a black dashed arrow with a filled arrowhead. Meaning: multiples of 4 inside multiples of 8 inside multiples of 32, i.e. the wrong nesting order (not the correct answer).
unclear: Faint watermark crosses the page; not part of the figure.

belongs_to: Question 16 (Figure it Out): 'Which of the following Venn diagrams captures the relationship between the multiples of 4, 8, and 32?' - option (iv) (printed answer: (iv)); reprinted with the question on the solutions page
description: Option (iv) of Q16, printed in the second row, right, small label '(iv)' to its upper left. Same layout as option (iii): THREE nested filled shapes, each wholly inside the next: OUTER large circle light blue; MIDDLE ellipse light yellow-green (inside the outer one, slightly right of and below its centre); INNER small circle medium green (inside the middle one, slightly right of and below its centre). Thin grey/dark outlines. Labels under the figure, left to right: 'Multiples of 4' with a dashed arrow from the lower-left rim of the outer blue ring pointing down-left (OUTER = multiples of 4); 'Multiples of 8' with a dashed arrow from the bottom edge of the middle ellipse pointing straight down (MIDDLE = multiples of 8); 'Multiples of 32' with a dashed arrow starting INSIDE the innermost green circle at its lower right, running down-right (INNER = multiples of 32). Each label is two lines of text ('Multiples' above 'of N') at the lower end of a black dashed arrow with a filled arrowhead. Meaning: multiples of 32 inside multiples of 8 inside multiples of 4 - the correct relationship; the book's printed answer is (iv).
